info.title: Future AGI attachment contract
info.description: Contract only. All media private; no support claim. Authentication eligibility and authorization are enforced per operation and occurrence.

post.description: Share ingestion project resolution; unknown policy retains no bytes. Invalid explicit workspace never falls back.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped to full tenant/parent/actor/session/operation. Identical normalized request replays; changed request returns 409.

post.description: Reserve capacity atomically; server binds writer/session and normalized parent. No write token authorizes existing links. Initialization authenticates the explicitly eligible original identity; the response delivers a secret upload-bound write capability. Never log response bodies; Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.description: Content-free status only for the capability-owned job.

post.description: Private envelope reference or registered completed provider output only. Provider connection authority is separate; write-only upload capabilities cannot select a connection. Single-attachment imports retain UploadRequest ceilings. mode=completed_recording uses RecordingImportRequest, reserves exact whole-source bytes plus a bounded output window, reads immutable source ranges no larger than min(max_upload_bytes, segment_bytes), and produces recording segments under both byte and duration limits. It requires a terminal completed source; it never starts a recorder or Egress. See README completed-recording protocol for length, reservation and publication invariants.

get.description: Require trace parent scope; per-item policy. Never expose locations, hashes, filenames or denied child counts.

post.description: Read-only handler, separate from mutations. Current viewer + expected parent for EACH item; unknown/foreign both not_found. Private no-store. Same-origin session-bound gateway only.

delete.description: Tombstone just this occurrence; generation fences in-flight work. Source parent provided in query; authorize full tuple.

put.description: Same registered recording/session/parent capability only; monotonically append ordered segments under reserved moving window; 1 MiB body ceiling. Never authorize arbitrary occurrence relinks. Requires recording_id in verified write-capability claims and complete operation. Every segment is bound to that recording/session/parent.

get.description: Authorize every surviving occurrence against expected parent. Source locations and speaker names are forbidden.

post.description: Authenticated application-session exchange; CSRF + exact Origin. Set host-only Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict fi_media_session cookie with Path=/tracer/v1/attachment-media/. Bound to original application session; revoke on logout/membership change.

get.description: Media session plus narrow occurrence grant; reauthorize before 200/206/304 and every bounded chunk (<=5s). No public storage/source URL. GET/HEAD/Range/conditional all private,no-store; nosniff; same-origin CORP; inert Content-Disposition. Range validated and bounded. Grant identifier alone is insufficient.

304.description: Authorized conditional response; never before authorization

head.description: Media session plus narrow occurrence grant; reauthorize before 200/206/304 and every bounded chunk (<=5s). No public storage/source URL. GET/HEAD/Range/conditional all private,no-store; nosniff; same-origin CORP; inert Content-Disposition. Range validated and bounded. Grant identifier alone is insufficient.

304.description: Authorized conditional response; never before authorization

get.description: Content-free status for the original scoped import identity and exact job. No upload capability, provider location or playback authority is returned. Foreign and absent jobs are indistinguishable.

AttachmentCredential.description: Eligible existing application identity or broker-issued narrow attachment write capability; never a provider key. This scheme does not widen existing ingest key eligibility.
